description: Search products across the United States by a 5-digit US ZIP code or served market. Read-only product facts and JENNi's best offer, without source-shop details. Sized goods are often listed one size per product: include the size in the query; when size is null it may be in the title. More results: call again with page+1 while page < paging.total_pages. Search results do not verify fulfillment eligibility. Lists local delivery first, filled with ship-to-home; fulfillment_mode searches one mode. Each page covers the next 20 ranked results and shows up to `limit` of them; use limit 20 to see every result. With fulfillment_mode omitted, pages follow the local list, and a page with nothing orderable locally shows ship-to-home products instead; for the full ship-to-home list, search with fulfillment_mode ship_to_home.

fulfillment_mode.description: Search one mode only. Omit to list local delivery first, filled with ship-to-home.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

page.description: 1-based results page; call again with page+1 while page < paging.total_pages.

query.description: What the shopper wants, e.g. "running shoes".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code the shopper is in, e.g. 78205.

name: search_catalog

delivers_here.description: The market we deliver in at that location; null when we deliver in none.

location.description: The place searched around; null for none.

note.description: Plain-language context for an empty or ship-only result.

paging.description: Number of result pages; call again with page+1 while page < total_pages. At most 42; 0 when nothing matched.

color.description: Colour of the variant product_id names; null when it has none.

description.description: Product description from the source catalog, when returned.

offers.description: JENNi's single best offer for this product (price, delivery_promise, fulfilled_by, is_eligible_checkout), without source-shop details.

availability.description: NULL when we have no shelf read under 24 hours old (shelf_observed_at says when). Null is not evidence of in-stock or out-of-stock state; checkout eligibility is independent.

delivery_promise.description: Shopper-facing delivery promise: "Get it today" only when the cutoff allows same-day, else "We'll deliver by <Month D>" (local delivery); "Ships to you" for ship_to_home.

fulfillment.description: `local_delivery`: delivered locally by JENNi (same-day only when delivery_promise says so). `ship_to_home`: shipped to the shopper by JENNi. `in_store_only`: observed, but it cannot be ordered through JENNi for this destination. Ordering happens with create_checkout and complete_checkout, or on the storefront link.

is_eligible_checkout.description: True when this offer is currently eligible for ordering through JENNi; false otherwise. Eligibility and price are checked again at hosted checkout. Nothing is charged until the buyer places the order on the checkout page.

price.description: USD, e.g. "$12.50". Null when we have no current price.

product_id.description: The exact variant this offer covers.

shelf_observed_at.description: When the shelf was last read. Null means never.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price for browsing, not a checkout price. Purchase price and checkout eligibility are separate fields.

ship_estimate.description: Display-only arrival window for a shipped order. An estimate, not a promise.

shipping_label.description: Plain-language label for shipping_price, e.g. "$7.99 flat shipping".

shipping_price.description: USD, e.g. "$7.99". The flat shipping fee for this order, present only on an offer the storefront can sell (an offer that ships from JENNi) when a fee is set. Absent means unstated, never free. Added at checkout on top of `price`.

url.description: Storefront page for this exact product.

price.description: Headline price in USD; null when there is none.

reason_code.description: Present when offers is empty: not_checked (no fulfillment mode was verified for this result) or not_served_locally.

shelf_price.description: Observed shelf price for browsing, not a checkout price. Purchase price and checkout eligibility are separate fields.

size.description: Size of the variant product_id names; null when none is recorded. Many items are listed one size per product, so a null size may be in the title (e.g. "..., Size 8"): match the shopper's size against it.

url.description: Storefront product page, where the buyer picks size/colour, checks out as a guest (email, no account) and pays. Null when no storefront is configured.

variants.description: Buyable size/colour variants and their product URLs. Search responses contain at most 30; detail responses may include all variants.

url.description: Storefront page opened on this variant.

reason_code.description: Present when products is empty: no_buyable_offer (matches exist, none orderable now) or product_not_found.

title: Search products
